name: qamap
description: Review a pull request from one local brief: the diff, the tests and callers of changed code, and change signals. No LLM call, no upload.

interface.longDescription: Review PR changes with local source and test evidence, affected behavior, and suggested QA checks. QAMap makes no model calls. An agent can interpret its bounded report, but still uses model tokens; missing evidence stays explicit and tests do not run automatically.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this branch with QAMap and show what must be verified before merge.
Trace this PR's highest-risk QA scenario to its exact diff evidence with QAMap.
Show QAMap's selected validation and its action contract before running anything.

publication.release_notes: QAMap 0.5.3 improves binding-aware caller and test evidence, bounded state/cache/lifecycle hints, parameterized test contracts and recovery of omitted diffs. Optional Git history has time limits and discloses shallow or missing evidence. The plugin requires the matching 0.5.3 CLI. Consent and execution boundaries remain unchanged; tests do not run automatically. No new token, speed, cost or review-quality improvement has been measured for this version.
